dialogues.speaker: Amateur Alchemist's Diary
dialogues.text: "...The third attempt at creating a cannonball fuse has failed. Fortunately, there were no explosions... But the issue remains the same: the reactant concentration is not up to par, and so no explosion can be possible..."

dialogues.speaker: Amateur Alchemist's Diary
dialogues.text: "...The third camp needs a batch of chilled drinks, and our Wolfhook stores are running low. This is quite odd. We'll have to count on our brothers in Mondstadt to deliver once again..."

dialogues.speaker: Amateur Alchemist's Diary
dialogues.text: "The fourth attempt at making fuses has failed. We discovered that Unmoving Essential Oil bottles can be adapted for use as the Safe Blasting Device's fuse. We could give that a shot..."

dialogues.speaker: Amateur Alchemist's Diary
dialogues.text: "...Clitopho has gone missing, and he's made off with our formula to boot! Erge's hopping mad. Looks like someone's about to be in hot stew."
